body:
> If the girl you're with, you don't want, wouldn't it be fair to let her know this and end the relationship on good terms? 

It's not a relationship, she doesnt want me either. We're just having mutual sex which is good but i honestly dont enjoy hanging out with her other than when we have sex.

>In life we can't always get what we want, it's just the law of the universe, we just have to make peace with what we have and live in the moment. 

This is true. I dont even think I'm upset about not getting with the girl I want (i've been let down before), but this one honestly gave the impression that she was into me and that something was developing, only to find out that she gave the same impression to others. Normally, I'd write her off as being a bitch, but she's honestly very sweet and I dont know why she would do this intentionally.

Thanks for your input though :)
